subject: Dedicated: tokens/sec & latency verification checklist + pricing follow-up
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Brooks <evelyn.brooks@spotlight.ai>
Cc: karchik_ignored@external.example.com
Date: 2026-10-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Dedicated: tokens/sec & latency verification checklist + pricing follow-up

Hi Evelyn,

Great meeting today — thanks for walking through Spotlight's Q4 production timelines. Per our discussion I attached a short template (redwood_dedicated_throughput_template_v3.xlsx) that captures the numbers we need to firm up throughput guarantees and the validation steps we propose for Dedicated. High-level items I want to confirm: 

- Committed GPU pool target: 8x A100-equivalent GPU slots (you indicated ~1M tokens/day steady state).
- Guarantee bands we typically offer: 95th percentile tokens/sec and 99th percentile single-request latency.
- Measurement window: 72-hour validation run during POC (we'll run the verification harness with your representative prompts).

Questions for you to answer in the template: expected peak concurrent requests, 90/95/99th latency SLOs for interactive vs batch flows, and whether PII-free test data is available for a realistic run.

Pricing note (preliminary): given the committed pool above, we can extend a 15% reserved-commit discount off list for a 12-month minimum. If Spotlight wants a firmer throughput SLA (tokens/sec guaranteed at 99%) we should treat that as an elevated SLO with a pricing add-on — I'll outline the measurement method below so you can see where risk sits.

Proposed measurement method (summary):
- Run: 72-hour continuous run using your (or synthetic equivalent) prompt set.
- Metrics: tokens/sec per GPU, end-to-end request latency (client library start to final token), and token-success ratio (no model OOMs or truncations).
- Routing: traffic hits the Dedicated pool only (no fallback to hosted). During the run we'll pin model version and quantization config.
- Pass criteria: sustained 95th-percentile tokens/sec >= committed value AND 99th-percentile latency <= agreed threshold across the 72h window.

I'll loop in Karthik from Infra for any kernel/quantization tradeoffs, and Marissa from ARR/proposals on the discounting side. If this outline looks OK, can we sync for a 30-minute POC planning call next week?

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0126

Attachments: redwood_dedicated_throughput_template_v3.xlsx
From: Evelyn Brooks <evelyn.brooks@spotlight.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@spotlight.ai
Date: 2026-10-26T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated: tokens/sec & latency verification checklist + pricing follow-up

Connor, thanks for the clear summary. A couple of clarifications from our side before we schedule POC planning: 

1) Pricing / guarantees: Spotlight needs two things for the board — (a) a committed tokens/sec guarantee for the 8-GPU pool (hard number), and (b) a latency target capped at 200ms p99 for our interactive product. If the standard 15% discount requires relaxing guarantees, share the exact tradeoff matrix.

2) Measurement: 72h is fine. Procurement wants the runbook up front (who triggers, our network setup, exact client-side commands). Also: will measurement run generate additional ingress egress costs we should expect?

3) Data: we can provide a de-identified prompt corpus (approx 150k tokens total) and a small test harness run by our infra. But we need Redwood's script to be runnable on our k8s environment.

Cc'ing procurement to start the MSA and to ask if there are any standard procurement templates you prefer.

Best,
Evelyn Brooks
Head of Engineering, Spotlight Analytics

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Brooks <evelyn.brooks@spotlight.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, procurement@spotlight.ai
Date: 2026-10-28T08:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated: tokens/sec & latency verification checklist + pricing follow-up

Evelyn — thanks, good points. Details below and attached a short SLA draft (SLA-draft-Spotlight-20261028.pdf) and the measurement runbook script (dedicated-measurement-runbook.sh). High level answers: 

- Firm numbers: for an 8x A100-equivalent pool our baseline (no additional SLO add-on) is a committed 18k tokens/sec aggregate (sustained, 95th across 72h). If you need a 99% hard guarantee at 18k tokens/sec we treat that as "Guaranteed Throughput" and add a 10% premium on top of the quoted reserved price to cover capacity overhead and on-call escalation.

- Latency: 200ms p99 for interactive is aggressive for long-completion prompts (>=512 tokens). We can guarantee 200ms p99 for single-token/short prompts (<64 tokens) at the same premium as above. For mixed prompt lengths we recommend a segmented SLO: 200ms p99 for short, 350ms p99 for medium (64–512 tokens), and 500ms p99 for long (>512). If Spotlight requires a blanket 200ms p99 across lengths we'll need the Guaranteed Throughput add-on + additional GPU headroom.

- Measurement runbook: attached script supports k8s execution and uses a client-side recorder to capture end-to-end latency. Network egress for the run is minimal (we're streaming tokens rather than large files). If you run it inside your VPC there are no Redwood egress charges; if you request Redwood to run from our Dedicated infra we'll include a small service surcharge on the final invoice.

- Next steps:
  1) Review attached SLA draft and mark any redlines.
  2) Fill the throughput template and return with your target SLOs and representative prompt set.
  3) Schedule a 45-minute POC kickoff (we'll include Karthik for runtime tuning and Marissa for pricing guardrails).

Marissa — can you confirm approval to offer the 15% reserved discount with the option for a +10% Guaranteed-Throughput add-on? Also note: we may need a 2-week reservation ramp for GPU headroom if Spotlight opts into the 99% guarantee.

Connor

Attachments: SLA-draft-Spotlight-20261028.pdf, dedicated-measurement-runbook.sh
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Brooks <evelyn.brooks@spotlight.ai>
Date: 2026-10-30T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated: tokens/sec & latency verification checklist + pricing follow-up

Looping in final pricing confirmation. We can approve: 15% reserved-commit discount for the 12-month commit tied to the 8-GPU baseline (18k tokens/sec, 95th over 72h). If Spotlight requires the 99% guaranteed throughput or a blanket 200ms p99 across all prompt lengths, we apply the Guaranteed-Throughput add-on (+10% on reserved rate) and require a 2-week capacity ramp in the contract.

Procurement: we'll accept Spotlight's standard PO template but need a short SOW appendix that calls out the measurement window, pass criteria, and ramp timeline. Connor — please add that appendix to the SLA draft and send back to Evelyn.

Marissa Cole
Director, ARR Pricing — Redwood Inference
